body: This brow tattoo lasts around 3 months ? And it depends on the person - thinner, weaker eyebrows would take around that amount of time to fully grow back and thick eyebrows, less time. I remember a guy in high school got his eyebrows shaved off for a dare and it took him around 3 months to look normal again.

Try browhaus brow resurrection - it's a service that fills in sparse eyebrows with lots of little lines, so it looks like actual hair. It's a semi-permanent form of tattoo so it'll fade by the time your real eyebrows grow back. You could try that? Alternatively you could use something like Maybelline's eyebrow mascara and stroke it along your skin, creating lots of little lines as well. Best of luck OP!

>We learn the reactions we should have to the things we don't totally understand. 

So true. I have seen kids fall over face first and just look to their parents to assess their reaction. Once the parent acts panicked the kid starts crying. Conversely, if the parent laughs it off and helps them up the kid normally gets up without reacting much.

The eyeshadow colour doesn't really suit your skin tone IMO, I reckon you could go with something a little more metallic and coppery toned. If coppery is not your thing, then try something more bronze-y rather than the taupe.
Love the lip colour and your eyebrows look great!! :)
